title: ‘Support PH cinema’: Bam Aquino holds block screenings of ‘Pee Mak,’ ‘2 Valid IDs’
summary: Senator Bam Aquino expressed his support for actress Bea Binene and her latest movie, “Pee Mak,” by hosting a block screening on Friday at a mall in Mandaluyong City.
